cases.proves_bugs: BUG-217 (CDPERIMETER: the drain on the plan carries its own PD1 tag text, and the prompts say perimeter drain, not AGI vertex / AGI drain; read from the command line and from the placed objects)
cases.title: CDPERIMETER with levels 18 and 17.9 says perimeter drain in every prompt (never AGI), places PD1 on the plan with a PD1 text on the drain's layer, and one U takes it back
cases.plan_item: Perimeter drain (triage group R2; daily card D07 neighbour); BUG-217
cases.reviewed_against: builder-filled: Opus review still needed. Compared by the builder on 25 Oct 2026 with BUG-217 in BUG_CARPARK.md (Codex pass 18: expected "the drain on the plan carries its own PD tag (PD1), matching the command line and the record"; seen: the plan repeated "AG" text and no PD tag, prompts said "AGI vertex" and "Place this AGI drain?"). BUG-236 (the PD1 text follows the drain on MOVE, ERASE, COPY) is R37b.
cases.expected: CDPERIMETER with two vertices (150000,-80000 and 152000,-80000), no outlet, levels 18 and 17.9 prints the Preview line with "Grade: 1:20" and "meets the office minimum 1:100", then "Place this perimeter drain? [Accept/Cancel] <Accept>:" and, on Accept, "Perimeter drain PD1 placed". One polyline and one text PD1 are added on layer AGI DRAIN. No prompt says "AGI vertex" or "Place this AGI drain". One U takes both back. The drawing file on disk is unchanged.
cases.why_not_unit: The prompts, the tag counter and the drawn tag text all come from the live command in the real drawing.
not_automated: That the PD1 text is visible and readable on the plan (its height, position and colour) is a Codex look; the case reads that a text PD1 exists on the drain's layer. BUG-236 (move, erase, copy) is R37b. The outlet choice and the Charged / Suspended property are not driven.
